chapters.label: Seventy minutes
chapters.text: Incheon, 2002, the World Cup. South Korea against Portugal, no goals yet. Lee Young-pyo crosses from the left. Park Ji-sung takes it on his chest, flicks it past a defender, and shoots. Goal!

chapters.label: Chest and flick
chapters.text: Watch again. His chest cushions the ball. Then a quick flick takes it past the defender.

chapters.label: Through the legs
chapters.text: From behind the goal: a left foot volley, right through the keeper's legs! Korea lead, one-nil!

chapters.label: Chest, then shoot
chapters.text: Like Park: control the ball with your chest, then shoot before the defender can block.
